## Overview

Building on last week's introduction to genAI and LLMs,
we will now get hands-on with agentic AI.
You will use Claude Code in VS Code to help you with coding tasks at OSC.

## Learning goals

#### [Coding with an AI agent in VS Code](./w9a_claude.qmd)

- Setting up and using the Claude extension in VS Code Server at OSC.
- Using Claude to ask questions about, write, and edit code.
- Letting Claude act as an "agent" that runs commands,
  and controlling what it may do with permission modes.
- Giving Claude persistent instructions (ones that carry over between conversations) with a `CLAUDE.md` file.
- Managing Claude's context window and costs.
